stories.title: Ravens QB Jackson sits out 2nd half of win after hurting ankle
stories.summary: Lamar Jackson left the Ravens' game against the Titans on Sunday with an ankle injury.

stories.title: Star WR Chase suffers concussion in Bengals' loss to Jaguars
stories.summary: Bengals wide receiver Ja'Marr Chase has been ruled out against the Jaguars with a concussion.

stories.title: Eagles RB Barkley suffers hamstring injury in loss to Rams
stories.summary: Eagles running back Saquon Barkley has been ruled out of Sunday's game against the Rams with a hamstring injury.

stories.title: Jets snag 1st interception in 21 games, snapping record drought
stories.summary: The Jets snapped one of the most ignominious droughts in NFL history Sunday when Minkah Fitzpatrick intercepted a pass by Bears quarterback Tyson Bagent.

stories.title: Mizzou rises, Florida falls after showdown; AP top 5 stand pat
stories.summary: Missouri jumped to No. 14 in the AP Top 25 following its rout of Florida, while the Gators dropped eight spots to No. 16 and were replaced by LSU in the top 10.
